description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Dark/Earth/Wind Ability Boost, Triplecast Dark/Earth/Wind, Unlimited Dark/Earth/Wind Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Dark/Earth/Wind Abilities, Dark/Earth/Wind Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Dark/Earth/Wind Abilities; Ends after using 8 Dark/Earth/Wind abilities
TP Max: AOE Dark/NE, Earth/NE or Wind/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Dark, En-Earth or En-Wind

description.name: War-Awoken Emperor's Tyranny (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Dark/Earth/Wind/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark/Earth/Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if target has 0-30%/40%+ imperil dark/earth/wind
WS Blue: Imperil Dark/Earth/Wind 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeShell 20% to all enemies
